description: GTFS Archive is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Pittsburgh Regional Transit. Overview The General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) is an Open Standard used to distribute relevant information about transit systems to riders. It allows public transit agencies to publish their transit data in a format that can be consumed by a wide variety of software applications. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Pittsburgh Regional Transit. Its tags are _etl, gtfs. It offers 109 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
